HEROIC.Title: Heroic Challenges
HEROIC.ToolHint: Your challenges and rewards: take a challenge, claim it as completed, and get a reward. The GM deals the cards and decides whether to count them. To open the window quickly, type /hc in chat.

Chat.Missing: This card was not found in the module data.

Item.Story: GM: enter the result into the game.
Item.NoActor: Item not granted: the player has no character assigned. GM: enter the result into the game.
Item.Failed: Item not granted. GM: enter the result into the game.
Item.FailedNotice: Could not grant the reward item.
Item.Used: The item from this reward has already been used, so a new one was not granted.

Click.Claim: Click if this option is complete
Click.ClaimAll: Click if the challenge is complete
Click.ClaimConfirm: Claim that this option is complete?
Click.ClaimAllConfirm: Claim that the whole challenge is complete?

Notice.ClickGone: This challenge is already completed or has been reset.
Notice.NoGM: The GM is not online: this action is not possible.
Notice.Reshuffled: The deck ran out, so the discard pile was reshuffled.
Notice.NoPlayers: No one to deal to: no players are online.
Notice.NothingDealt: Nothing to deal: everyone's hands are full.
Notice.DeckEmpty: No cards are left in the deck.
Notice.TransferFailed: Could not transfer the card: the recipient's hand is full.
Notice.ClaimPending: A claim for this card is already waiting for the GM's decision.
Notice.NoRecipients: No one to give the reward to: no players are online.
Notice.CardGone: The challenge has already been reset or transferred, so the claim was declined.
Notice.RewardsEmpty: No cards are left in the reward deck.
Notice.DecksReset: The decks have been gathered again.
Notice.NoPlayersAtAll: No one to deal to: there are no players in the world.
Notice.PendingLost: Rewards without a card in chat: {n}. They have been returned to the discard pile.

Window.NoPlayers: There are no players in the world yet, so there is no one to deal challenges to.
Window.DiscardConfirm: Discard the challenge without a reward?
Window.ResetConfirm: All cards will return to their decks, and the challenges in players' hands will be removed. Continue?
Window.ClaimPending: The claim is waiting for the GM's decision.

Tools.DealHint: Each player receives challenges until they have the required number of cards in hand (or a shared challenge for the group).

sets.Title: Additional sets
sets.Hint: The Core Set is always included.

decisions.Title: Who decides
decisions.Hint: The GM always has the final say.

setPP.Name: Power and Prowess
setPP.Hint: An expansion about combat and might: 25 challenges and 25 rewards.

setVV.Name: Vice and Virtue
setVV.Hint: An expansion about morals and character: 25 challenges and 25 rewards.

setBonus.Name: Bonus Challenges
setBonus.Hint: 25 additional challenges. Their rewards come from the connected reward decks.

drawMode.Name: How to deal challenges
drawMode.Hint: Each player gets their own challenge, one challenge for the whole group, or a session theme that the GM reveals.

handSize.Name: Challenges in a player's hand
handSize.Hint: How many challenges a player can hold at the same time.

dealTo.Name: Who to deal to
dealTo.Hint: The GM does not receive challenges.

handVisibility.Name: Who can see a player's challenges
handVisibility.Hint: A hidden challenge is visible only to its owner; the GM learns the card when the player claims completion.

epic.Name: Epic difficulty
epic.Hint: Both options of the card must be completed, and the player receives two rewards.

swapPolicy.Name: Replacing a challenge
swapPolicy.Hint: Whether a player may take a different challenge if this one does not suit the character.

playerParticipates.Name: Player takes part in decisions
playerParticipates.Hint: The player draws a challenge themselves, gives it up, and chooses the result of their own reward. If this is off, the GM does everything.

playerClaims.Name: Player claims completion
playerClaims.Hint: The player can report that they completed a challenge. The GM still decides whether to count it.

rewardItems.Name: Items for rewards
rewardItems.Hint: Rewards that are spent in play (rerolls, automatic successes, and so on) are granted as an item: it disappears after use. Story rewards are entered by the GM.
